name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: O'Hare Precision's only active channel this period is Google Business Profile, which drove 188 total actions (134 directions, 11 calls, 43 web clicks) over 28 days, but GBP engagement dropped 54.35% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely reflecting reduced search demand or a dip in profile visibility. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads, so reactivating paid campaigns should be the immediate priority to generate measurable lead volume.

performance.verdict: GBP collapsing, paid dark 28 days; CRM delivery overdue gates recovery.

findings.text: 3 overdue CRM milestones (Jul 7, Jul 28, Jul 31) unconfirmed complete; dedup workbook of 447 groups and 126 accounts at risk of blocking Sales-i sync.
Zero paid spend across Meta and Google Ads for all 28 days in window; CPL is undefined and lead volume is 0 — no efficiency to measure.
GBP actions dropped 54.35% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 28–30) summed 1 action vs prior 3 days (Aug 25–27) summing 13 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not noise.
Search clicks held flat (sc_7d_pct = 0%, 432 clicks over 28 days) while GBP collapses — divergence suggests profile-specific visibility loss, not a demand drop.
GA4 sessions are 0 for all 45 days in series; this is a data gap (likely disconnected property), not zero web traffic — directional data is missing entirely.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP profile for suppressions, missing hours, or category changes causing the 54.35% action drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 54.35% week-over-week and hit 1 total action over Aug 28–30 vs 13 in the prior 3 days. Search clicks remained flat at 432/28 days, pointing to a profile-level issue rather than a demand drop — check for suppression, incorrect hours, category drift, or a missing Q&A flag. Success check: GBP daily actions return above 7/day (the 28-day average) within 7 days of the fix. Re-check by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Escalate the 3 overdue CRM milestones (Jul 7, Jul 28, Jul 31) to Ahmed and Sohib; 447-group merge and 342 stub reconciliation are blocking Sales-i sync.
suggestions.monday_update: Three CRM milestones are unconfirmed complete as of 2026-08-31: 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list prioritisation (Jul 28), and dedup workbook + 126 accounts delivery (Jul 31). Until the 447-group merge workbook is executed in audited batches and 342 stub accounts are reconciled, Sales-i cannot sync correctly and the inactivity automation is running on dirty data. Success check: Ahmed posts rollback files to the Monday CRM board and confirms milestone closure by 2026-09-07.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 data gap — 0 sessions for 45 days indicates a disconnected property; confirm before any paid reactivation decision.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions have read 0 for all 45 days in the available series, which is a known possible data gap, not confirmed zero traffic. Before paid channels (Meta or Google Ads) are reactivated, the GA4 property connection must be verified so conversion tracking is reliable. Success check: at least 1 confirmed session recorded in GA4 matching a known site visit. Re-check by 2026-09-03.
